explanation: The top-level corpus contains eight qualifying demand records with demand_score >= 3, including n06-r06. Job 2 consumed only seven needs and seven evidence_sources, both missing n06-r06. The upstream normalize function is the supported localization because its allowed_record_ids list contains n06-r09 instead of n06-r06 and then filters retained records to that list, silently dropping the stipulated n06-r06 record before the downstream handoff. Job 2's map_coverage would have allowed n06-r06 if present, so the observed omission originates upstream.
